links.outcome: AI vs interventional cardiologists on IVUS stent expansion and geographic miss assessment, same data
links.effect: AVVIGO+ reported lower mean expansion (70.3% vs 91.2%, p<0.0001); 25 discordant cases; identified PB ≥50% missed by IC in 12 cases; analysis time 0.76 vs 1.89 min.
links.quote: AVVIGO™ + consistently identified lower mean expansion (70.3 %) vs. IC (91.2 %), (p < 0.0001), primarily due to detecting frames with smaller MSA values (5.94 vs. 7.19 mm<sup>2</sup>, p = 0.0053).

screen.reason: Retrospective study comparing the diagnostic performance and efficiency of an FDA-approved AI software (AVVIGO+) against interventional cardiologists in evaluating IVUS stent optimization.
